data.leadership_messages: USG acknowledges that NGC has not yet received Supplier Schedule information. USG will rate confidence levels based on available information with the understanding that a more robust review will occur once the supplier data has been delivered. The lack of Supplier data, combined with the lack of presentable draft data contributes to a low confidence rating at this time.
